section: 1/1/2026Enacted by Chapter 336, 2025 General Session2025Technically renumbered to avoid duplication of newly enacted code also in SB0207, Chapter 339, also in SB0200, Chapter 336.also in HB0378, Chapter 258, also in SB0207, Chapter 339.Definitions.As used in this chapter:"Canoe" means the same as that term is defined in Section 59-2-405."Division" means the Motor Vehicle Division created in Section 41-1a-106."Government entity" means the United States, state, county, municipality, or any political subdivision."Jon boat" means the same as that term is defined in Section 59-2-405.2."Personal watercraft" means the same as that term is defined in Section 73-18-2."Pontoon" means the same as that term is defined in Section 59-2-405.2."Sailboat" means the same as that term is defined in Section 73-18-2."Utility boat" means the same as that term is defined in Section 59-2-405.2."Vessel" means the same as that term is defined in Section 73-18-2.
